Jake, saw Data Dimensions keeps investing in automation across its digital mailroom and BPO for P&C and workers' comp.

A growing partner and channel ecosystem usually means more co-sell accounts in play than your team can cover, so partner-sourced pipeline never gets worked at scale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the ecosystem autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

The BD bottleneck is rarely the deals, it is coverage: too many partner and prospect accounts, not enough hands to work them before they cool. That is exactly where co-sourced pipeline slips through the cracks.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook showing how Data Dimensions could cover the full ecosystem without adding headcount, and the math on meetings it should generate.
